title: How 50 Surviving Otters Rebuilt A Carbon Shield
hook: A near-extinction accidentally revealed how otters protect coastal carbon.
closing: Saving otters restores a predator, its kelp habitat, and a natural carbon store.
question: Would you protect otters near you?

segments.say: Only 50 sea otters survived the fur trade. That tiny remnant became California's entire recovery base.
Those survivors grew into about 3,000 otters. Their comeback returned a crucial predator to coastal kelp.
Otter-protected kelp can store up to 8.7 million metric tons of CO2 yearly. Recovery now safeguards a carbon sink.
